subject: CI flake blocking connector demo — request for safety-net credits & extension
messages:
From: Elena Zhou <elena@trellisai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Demo scheduled but CI flakes blocking our integration — can we get temporary credits/extension?

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team was impressed with the latency numbers. We're trying to get the connector wired into our CI so we can run end-to-end tests, but we're hitting a recurring CI flake where the connector process crashes on a particular serialization path. The tests pass locally but fail in CI (~20% of runs). Our SREs are tied up and this is blocking the scheduled feature demo for our execs next Friday.

Given the uncertainty, we'd like to ask for two things while we debug: 1) a short trial extension (2–3 weeks) so our evaluation window doesn't expire mid-fix, and 2) a small, temporary credit top‑up so our CI runs don't burn through the sandbox tokens while the team chases the flake. If you can provision a short safety‑net we can keep the demo timeline intact.

I've attached the latest CI failure log and a screenshot of the failing step. If helpful I can set up a short call with our lead engineer (cc'd here) tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Zhou
Head of Platform Engineering, TrellisAI
elena@trellisai.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: ci-failure-log.txt (text), connector-test-screenshot.png (image)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Zhou <elena@trellisai.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 17:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo scheduled but CI flakes blocking our integration — can we get temporary credits/extension?

Hi Elena,

I'm sorry to hear the CI flake is getting in the way — thanks for sending the logs. I reviewed them quickly: looks like a serialization edge-case in our connector on long batched payloads. I want to escalate this to our engineering on-call and propose two immediate options so you can keep momentum:

- Provisional safety-net: we can provision a 10k token sandbox credit right away so your CI runs won't exhaust the trial while we triage.
- Trial extension: we can pause the trial expiry and extend your access for 14 days once engineering confirms a repro.

I need to get internal sign-off for the formal top-up (credits + extension). Would you be available for a 30‑minute debug session tomorrow at 1pm PT with your lead engineer? That will help us reproduce in our staging environment and speed a fix.

I'll loop in my AE and CS to coordinate approvals and make sure we record this in the deal.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

- Ask: short trial extension (2–3 weeks) + small token top-up so CI can continue running.
- Timing: demo for execs planned next Friday; customer is blocked.

Proposed request for approval: 20k provisional sandbox tokens + a 21-day trial extension, contingent on delivery of a quick repro (we can reduce if engineering says 10k is sufficient). Marissa, can CS prepare a brief mitigation plan/hand-hold to keep them moving? Thanks for the context, Jasmine.

Approve a targeted safety-net: 15k sandbox tokens + a 14-day extension. Rationale: this is an engineering flake and we want to keep the demo on track but remain disciplined about credits. Condition approval on:
1) Ben updating the HubSpot deal with the credit note and revised demo date (DEAL-98214).
2) Marissa offering one scheduled triage session (30–45 minutes) with Trellis engineering and a short follow-up checklist (shared in Drive).
3) Jasmine to confirm reproduction in our staging within 48 hours — if internal engineering cannot repro within that window, we will step in to reproduce with their CI artifacts.

Marissa/Ben — please confirm when done so I can mark this closed on my side.

Kimberly Park
